notes: Smoother: no pause when a view first appears.
Bots start shooting as soon as a siege begins.
Castle beams show their wood, stone and metal at every zoom.
Royals are bigger, about a room tall, so you can see who is who.
Bots build huts that fit their royals, even on slopes.
Bots shelter their royals on hilly ground.
Royals are drawn to the same scale as castles.
New look for the royals, with faces you can read.
A border of beasts and birds runs along the top.
Trees on the hills.
The siege view no longer shows past the edge of the world.
Finer aim: a slightly later release throws slightly farther.
Bots no longer freeze the game at the start of a siege.
The trebuchet now swings at a steady speed, with a real sling and counterweight.
Its longest throw is shorter.
The camera stays on the trebuchet for a moment after each throw.
First playable version: build a castle, then besiege your rivals.
Play against bots, or with friends online.
Everything is stitched in wool on linen.
Menus, settings and the online lobby.
